notes: Primary finding MC-4 (Scenario 4, registration race, no fault needed): DatanodeManager.registerDatanode exports the NameNode's block keys into the registration reply before the node joins HeartbeatManager.datanodes; a HeartbeatManager.Monitor key roll that lands between export and join flags only nodes already joined, so the registering DataNode keeps a key set without the new next key and needKeyUpdate=false; at the following roll that key becomes the NameNode currentKey, clients and peer DataNodes present DEKs on it, and the DataNode's retrieveDataEncryptionKey finds allKeys.get(keyId)==null and throws InvalidEncryptionKeyException. Reproduced from a variant of the workload TestEncryptedTransfer#testEncryptedAppendRequiringBlockTransfer in the same module on the pinned base with timing control only (a pass-through hosts provider pausing inside registration, the existing setKeyUpdateIntervalForTesting hook, triggerHeartbeat); the workload append failed to the application and a no-race control passed. The frame reports line 422 because the single throw statement spans lines 420-422 (javap maps the new to 420 and the constructor call to 422); it is the method's only throw. Every one of the six hunt configs and six steady-cluster cross-checks (oracle TargetSafeAfterFault) violated; the fault-free control MC_control.cfg (907,004 distinct states, diameter 37) and the workload MC.cfg held. All six model findings were reproduced as REPRODUCED with the target exception thrown at BTSM.java:420-422: MC-1 safe mode spanning two key rolls (NEW), MC-2 Balancer DEK never refreshed (KNOWN, fixed upstream as HDFS-11741), MC-3 one lost heartbeat response (FAULT, KNOWN unfixed HDFS-13441), MC-4, MC-5 HA standby restart key space (RESTART, KNOWN fixed HDFS-17383), MC-6 non-HA NameNode restart before DataNode re-registration (RESTART, NEW). Code-review CR-3 (stale client DEK in pipeline recovery, KNOWN HDFS-10609) also fired the target; CR-1 (NullPointerException from the failing branch when currentKey is null) is MASKED and is not a TargetSafe confirmation. Bounds 'states' are distinct states.
